sections.text: مقدمة

This document out 
 lines the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every two year as indicated by Y2 
 in the above title block.

تم استخدام مروحة السحب القسري 
 لتزويد الغلاية بهواء الاحتراق، تستخدم مروحة GR لزيادة عملية إعادة التسخين 
 درجة الحرارة، ومروحة SL تستخدم لتزويد الغلاية بهواء مانع للتسرب.

The 
 first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla Mohamed Abdalla, reviewed by director eng. Gamal 
 Mahmoud Ahmed Arafa, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Abd El-Salam Mahmoud, 
 and approved by eng: Michael Goerge: 
 head sector of Ayoun Moussa steam power station 2x320 MW

This document is accepted by eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued; the
qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence with caution marks must be surrounding the work
area is required,

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
safety shoes....
إلخ
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of the required fan.
Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor of the required fan.
Isolate the required fan mechanically.

Carried Out

Fan 
Disassembly Sequence (see Figures 1, 2, 3, 4 )
Disconnect the coupling between the fan rotor and motor rotor.
Remove the suction screen bolt.
Remove the suction screen by using the hoist.
قم بإزالة مسمار كاتم الصوت.
قم بإزالة كاتم الصوت باستخدام الرافعة.
Remove the inlet cones tighting bolts.
Remove the fan upper half housing bolt.
Remove the fan upper half housing.
Remove the bearing instruments.
Remove the bearing coupling water hoses and fitting.
Drain the bearings oil.
Remove the bearing upper half.
قم بإزالة الدوار ومخاريط المدخل باستخدام الرافعة.
